parameters.name: api_host
parameters.description: The URL to the Datadog API. Default value is https://api.datadoghq.com. This value can also be set with the DATADOG_HOST environment variable.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your Datadog API key.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Your Datadog app key.

parameters.name: escalation_message
parameters.description: A message to include with a re-notification. Supports the ‘@username’ notification we allow elsewhere. Not applicable if renotify_interval=none.

parameters.name: evaluation_delay
parameters.description: Time to delay evaluation (in seconds). Effective for sparse values.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the alert. If set, it is used instead of name to locate the alert.

parameters.name: include_tags
parameters.description: Whether notifications from this monitor automatically inserts its triggering tags into the title. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: Whether changes to this monitor should be restricted to the creator or admins. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the alert.

parameters.name: new_host_delay
parameters.description: A positive integer representing the number of seconds to wait before evaluating the monitor for new hosts. This gives the host time to fully initialize.

parameters.name: no_data_timeframe
parameters.description: The number of minutes before a monitor notifies when data stops reporting. Must be at least 2x the monitor timeframe for metric alerts or 2 minutes for service checks. If not specified, it defaults to 2x timeframe for metric, 2 minutes for service.

parameters.name: notification_message
parameters.description: A message to include with notifications for this monitor. Email notifications can be sent to specific users by using the same ‘@username’ notation as events. Monitor message template variables can be accessed by using double square brackets, in other words [[ and ]].

parameters.name: notification_preset_name
parameters.description: Toggles the display of additional content sent in the monitor notification. Choices: "show_all" "hide_query" "hide_handles" "hide_all"

parameters.name: notify_audit
parameters.description: Whether tagged users are notified on changes to this monitor. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: notify_no_data
parameters.description: Whether this monitor notifies when data stops reporting. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Integer from 1 (high) to 5 (low) indicating alert severity.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The monitor query to notify on. Syntax varies depending on what type of monitor you are creating.

parameters.name: renotify_interval
parameters.description: The number of minutes after the last notification before a monitor re-notifies on the current status. It only re-notifies if it is not resolved.

parameters.name: renotify_occurrences
parameters.description: The number of times re-notification messages should be sent on the current status at the provided re-notification interval.

parameters.name: renotify_statuses
parameters.description: The types of monitor statuses for which re-notification messages are sent. Choices: "alert" "warn" "no data"

parameters.name: require_full_window
parameters.description: Whether this monitor needs a full window of data before it gets evaluated. We highly recommend you set this to false for sparse metrics, otherwise some evaluations are skipped. Choices: false true

parameters.name: silenced
parameters.description: Dictionary of scopes to silence, with timestamps or None. Each scope is muted until the given POSIX timestamp or forever if the value is None.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The designated state of the monitor. Choices: "present" "absent" "mute" "unmute"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A list of tags to associate with your monitor when creating or updating. This can help you categorize and filter monitors.

parameters.name: thresholds
parameters.description: A dictionary of thresholds by status. Only available for service checks and metric alerts. Because each of them can have multiple thresholds, we do not define them directly in the query. If not specified, it defaults to: {'ok': 1, 'critical': 1, 'warning': 1}.

parameters.name: timeout_h
parameters.description: The number of hours of the monitor not reporting data before it automatically resolves from a triggered state.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the monitor. The types query alert, trace-analytics alert and rum alert were added in community.general 2.1.0. The type composite was added in community.general 3.4.0. The type event-v2 alert was added in community.general 4.8.0. Choices: "metric alert" "service check" "event alert" "event-v2 alert" "process alert" "log alert" "query alert" "trace-analytics alert" "rum alert" "composite"

examples:
- name: Create a metric monitor
  community.general.datadog_monitor:
    type: "metric alert"
    name: "Test monitor"
    state: "present"
    renotify_interval: 30
    renotify_occurrences: 1
    renotify_statuses: ["warn"]
    notification_preset_name: "show_all"
    query: "datadog.agent.up.over('host:host1').last(2).count_by_status()"
    notification_message: "Host [[host.name]] with IP [[host.ip]] is failing to report to datadog."
    api_key: "9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4"
    app_key: "87ce4a24b5553d2e482ea8a8500e71b8ad4554ff"

- name: Deletes a monitor
  community.general.datadog_monitor:
    name: "Test monitor"
    state: "absent"
    api_key: "9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4"
    app_key: "87ce4a24b5553d2e482ea8a8500e71b8ad4554ff"

- name: Mutes a monitor
  community.general.datadog_monitor:
    name: "Test monitor"
    state: "mute"
    silenced: '{"*":None}'
    api_key: "9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4"
    app_key: "87ce4a24b5553d2e482ea8a8500e71b8ad4554ff"

- name: Unmutes a monitor
  community.general.datadog_monitor:
    name: "Test monitor"
    state: "unmute"
    api_key: "9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4"
    app_key: "87ce4a24b5553d2e482ea8a8500e71b8ad4554ff"

- name: Use datadoghq.eu platform instead of datadoghq.com
  community.general.datadog_monitor:
    name: "Test monitor"
    state: "absent"
    api_host: https://api.datadoghq.eu
    api_key: "9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4"
    app_key: "87ce4a24b5553d2e482ea8a8500e71b8ad4554ff"
